name: WARNING: Olive Garden Warm Garlic Breadsticks (Garlic Margarine Brush)
whyItWorks: Rolled yeast bread baked fresh and heavily coated with melted margarine, garlic salt, and artificial butter flavoring. The concentrated garlic powder and grease trigger bloating, gas spasms, and acid reflux.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask server for 'plain breadsticks with NO garlic butter topping' if you tolerate wheat, or skip breadsticks entirely.
